moonray.title: MoonRay
moonray.description: DreamWorks' production path tracer, as a renderer for the viewport and for final renders.

cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.description: Blender's path tracer, on the CPU, as a renderer for the viewport and for final renders.

arnold.title: Arnold
arnold.description: Autodesk's Arnold as a renderer for the viewport and for final renders. The plugins only, without Arnold itself: name your own Arnold of this version, or a later one of the same 7.x, in Settings > Renderers > Arnold folder. Without an Arnold licence, renders have a watermark.

gatling.title: Gatling
gatling.description: A GPU path tracer with MDL materials. Needs a GPU with Vulkan ray tracing.
